build_recipe1m_vocab: build ingredient and instruction vocabularies from the Recipe1M dataset and save pickle files
create_Vocabulary_class: create a Vocabulary class that maps words to integer indices with special token support
run_cluster_ingredients: run the cluster_ingredients function to group related ingredient tokens by shared subwords
run_remove_plurals: run the remove_plurals function to merge plural ingredient entries into their singular forms
run_get_ingredient: run the get_ingredient function to normalize and clean a detected ingredient text entry
